title: Claude Code Is Secretly Just a While Loop
description:
Claude Code is secretly just a while loop, and here's the proof. Everything an AI agent actually is comes down to a language model, a loop, and some tools. The model can't remember anything, can't browse your files, and can't run commands. All it does is predict text. So how does it edit your code? It outputs text formatted as a tool call, structured as JSON. 

The harness, which is just regular software, parses that, actually runs the command, and pipes the result back into the prompt. Then the loop runs again. That's the whole thing. Memory files, skills, MCP servers, guardrails, all of it is just text getting stuffed into the context window before each prediction. 

Once you see it, you can't unsee it.

#techwithtim #ai #aiengineer #programming
